coordinateConvention: All body/spine/envelope/context rectangles are top-left source-raster integer pixels [left,top,right,bottom), not detector-normalized boxes. Bodies were chosen from source views; larger rectangles intentionally retain crossing staff ink. They do not label every pixel as notehead.
scope: Seven genuine notehead/stem positives, two deliberately wrong head-to-nearby-barline associations, thirteen known structural false witnesses. Real source controls complement frozen synthetic 180/36; do not replace them.
coverageGap: No confirmed real musical single spine traversing two complete staff cores was found in the reviewed contexts. Positive ordinary/ledger stems cannot certify recovery of ambiguous long cross-staff stems.

sourceVisualReview: Each selected source crop and surrounding source context is reviewed independently before candidate code/results.

evaluationContract.positive: For the supplied body and its genuine tested musical stem, evidence must not classify the body as purely structural. Independently retain the fixed source note envelope in any applicable output crop. Ordinary source notes do not necessarily enter the long-spine preservation path; report not-exercised rather than automatic success.
evaluationContract.negative: No notehead ownership may be transferred to the tested structural spine from this source patch. Structural-negative classification does not authorize deleting the nearby genuine note, tie, slur, or staff-owned marking.
evaluationContract.attachment: Direct musical attachment excludes paths that only go sideways along staff/ledger lines to another stem. Near-head cases reuse exactly the same source body with a different tested spine.
evaluationContract.counting: Report evidence accept/reject/not-exercised separately from final crop-envelope containment. No all-score recall claim.
